title: Immigration and Entrepreneurship: The Role of Enclaves
eligible_reason: No binary staggered treatment. Main results (Tables 2-4) are local-authority long-difference cross-sections (change in log Polish-founded businesses 2004-2008) on the continuous change in Polish NINo registrations per population, interacted with a time-invariant enclave indicator (top-5% 2001 Polish-born share), with region dummies and baseline controls, OLS and 2SLS with shift-share (Irish occupational growth) and historical-camp instruments. The FE panel models (Table A-9, 'FE panel models.do') regress log business entry on the continuous NINo share and its interaction with the enclave dummy plus time-varying local controls, with year and LTLA FE. Firm-level outcomes use logit and Cox models. The prescore of 2 reflects the reghdfe panel with unit and year FE, not a DiD.
design_notes: Main.do (Tables 1-4, A-1 to A-15, Figures 1, 3, 4). Unit: lower-tier local authority (LTLA16CD). Treatment: delta_nino_sharepop_0307 (continuous), enclave: perc_polishborn_2001_95 (time-invariant). Instruments: IRL_AutIVoccIS06M3_AO1_c91 (shift-share), gravB12_FAM_for51 / SR_B12_* (historical Polish resettlement camps). FE panel models.do: reghdfe ln_nbizPF_lead1 nino_sharepop c.nino_sharepop#c.perc_polishborn_2001_95 ln_pop_ ... edu_rate_ if year 2002-2015, absorb(year LTLA16CDid) cluster(regionid). Survival.do (stcox), Financial_perf.do (logit).
